items.title: Is Verizon’s Debt Redemption And Hyperscaler Dark Fiber Pivot Reframing The Investment Case For VZ?
items.summary: In August 2026, Verizon Communications announced it would redeem in full its US$1.25 billion 4.329% Notes due 2028 on September 21, 2026, at a price based on a Treasury Rate calculation plus 25 basis points and accrued interest. Away from this balance sheet step, Verizon is reshaping its story by emphasizing combined connectivity metrics and dark fiber contracts with hyperscalers that are expected to start contributing from 2027.
